name: cg_derivatives_exchanges
description:
Crypto derivatives exchanges from CoinGecko (derivatives/exchanges).
Returns {exchanges: [{id, name, open_interest_btc, trade_volume_24h_btc, number_of_perpetual_pairs, number_of_futures_pairs, year_established, country, url, ...}]}.
Inputs: none.
For individual contracts use cg_derivatives; spot venues are in cg_exchanges_list.
Example: {}
No API key is sent (CoinGecko public API, rate-limited by CoinGecko); a failed call returns {"error": ...}.
